self_assessment: Refactored Topics.validateTags to accept an optional tid, diff submitted tags against currentTags (empty on create, loaded via Topics.getTopicTags on edit) into addedTags/removedTags, and reject non-privileged add/remove of meta.config.systemTags with cant-use-system-tag/cant-remove-system-tag while keeping minTags/maxTags checks independent; threaded tid through the only edit call site (src/posts/edit.js, which both HTTP and Socket.IO post-edit paths already funnel through) and added SocketTopics.canRemoveTag per the interface spec; verified with node --check and manual trace of all call sites (topics/create.js, posts/queue.js, posts/edit.js, api/topics.js, api/posts.js, socket.io/topics.js, socket.io/posts/edit.js) since no live Mongo/Redis + npm install was available to run the real test suite (test/topics.js system-tag tests were reviewed for compatibility but not executed) — recommend running `uv`/npm test in a full environment before merging.
